json-lines-converter.name: JSON / JSON Lines Converter
json-lines-converter.description: Convert JSON arrays to JSON Lines (NDJSON) and back, preserving large numbers. Import local files, copy or download the result.

meta.title: JSON / JSON Lines Converter
meta.description: Convert JSON arrays to JSON Lines (NDJSON) and back, preserving large numbers. Import local files, copy or download the result.
meta.keywords: JSON Lines, NDJSON, JSONL, JSON array converter, log conversion

jsonLines.fileHint: UTF-8 .json, .jsonl, .ndjson or .txt; up to 5 MiB. The file extension selects the direction.
jsonLines.hint: Convert log exports and datasets locally. Up to 5 MiB, 50,000 records and 100 nesting levels. Large integers and decimal precision are preserved.
jsonLines.rules: JSON input must be an array. Each JSON Lines record can be any JSON value, including null or an array. Use LF or CRLF line endings; a final newline is allowed. Blank lines are counted when skipped. Invalid records and conflicting duplicate object keys stop conversion.
jsonLines.emptyResult: An empty array produces an empty JSON Lines file. You can still download it.

errors.empty: Enter a JSON array or at least one JSON Lines record.
errors.tooLarge: Input exceeds the 5 MiB UTF-8 limit.
errors.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check syntax and conflicting duplicate keys.
errors.expectedArray: JSON input must be a top-level array.
errors.blankLine: Blank line at line {line}. Enable skipping blank lines or remove it.
errors.invalidLine: Invalid JSON record at line {line}. Check syntax and conflicting duplicate keys.
errors.encoding: The file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 and retry.
errors.fileRead: Unable to read the file. Select it again.
errors.download: Download failed. Copy the output instead.
